name: Tzimos
shortBio: Rapper from Heraklion, Crete and co-founder of Maskes, returning after 8 years with Reboot produced by Phone Memo.
bio: Tzimos is a rapper from Heraklion, Crete and co-founder of the hip hop crew Maskes alongside Ace Beats, Abyss, Doc, and Rade.
Following several releases in the 2010s, he returns after an 8-year hiatus with Reboot, a comeback EP fully produced by Phone Memo.
Reboot marks a fresh beginning and reintroduction of Tzimos to the hip hop scene.

name: Phone Memo
shortBio: Production, hosting and session direction from initial spark to final bounce.
bio: Phone Memo serves as the production core of the series: crafting beats, guiding studio direction, hosting, and gluing each episode together.
His goal is giving artists the creative freedom to explore, while keeping sessions tight and focused so beats and verses come together on the spot.

name: Le Snipe VFX
shortBio: Visual identity, dynamic editing, VFX and gritty film aesthetic.
bio: Le Snipe VFX / Myron Sfyrakis drives the visual dimension of the series: camera work, editing, VFX, grain textures, and rhythm in the final cut.
Visuals are approached as an organic part of the track, far beyond standard behind-the-scenes documentation.

name: Redemption Studio / Dimitris Tsekeris
shortBio: Mixing, mastering, and engineering the sonic polish.
bio: Redemption Studio / Dimitris Tsekeris handles mix and master engineering, keeping the audio cohesive, punchy, and clear.
His contribution anchors the critical final step: transforming raw takes, fresh beats, and spontaneous studio energy into an official listening experience.

name: Nesom
shortBio: Rapper from Heraklion, Crete, featured on the second Rap Sta Bam session.
bio: Nesom is a rapper hailing from Heraklion, Crete and the featured guest of Rap Sta Bam Session #002.
During the session, he breaks down his musical roots, influences, and the unfiltered studio process before tracks reach final form.
He dives into the session from complete scratch: beat creation, live lyrics, trial, error, and the final cut recorded in one room.

name: Chozen
shortBio: Rapper and featured guest for Rap Sta Bam Session #003.
bio: Chozen is the third guest artist featured on Rap Sta Bam.
Entering the studio with no pre-written material, the beat, writing, and vocals take shape live right in front of the lens.
Full episode details and tracks will unlock upon premiere.

name: Black Spirit
shortBio: Rapper and featured guest for Rap Sta Bam Session #004.
bio: Black Spirit is the fourth guest artist featured on Rap Sta Bam.
Stepping into the studio with zero pre-written verses, beatmaking, writing, and recording unfold live in a single continuous session.
Full episode content, videos, and audio tracks will unlock upon premiere.
